args:
Marvelous! A truly inspiring display.

You outwitted your opponent, then sealed the deal with overwhelming skill.

Harle, I presume?

The smirking chief of the Capital Guard?

It seems you've spared me the need of an introduction—

although I certainly would have picked different traits to highlight.

This guy's as irritating as straw underwear, but he's not our enemy.

I'll fill you in while we catch each other up.

Actually, I've had many a person sing my charming praises.

But so long as you're willing to trust me, I'm happy to join in your little palaver.
...Got it. That all makes sense to me.

It's not especially complicated.

Basileus and Graht want to bring Satan back.

To do so, they need the fragments that form his body,

a vessel to be his heart, and his soul from another world.

The Archdemons had the fragments, so Graht's already got those.

Basileus says he'll be the vessel, so that's checked off too.

Which just leaves the soul, and for that, they need a Sacred Shard with Metatron's mana,

plus 666 human sacrifices.

Sounds like Harle's impostor almost surely has the Shard,

and we think they're gonna do something sacrifice-y at the Auspecalia.

My independent investigation also suggests

they're going to do something nefarious at the festival.

Graht's been very involved with planning the celebration this year,

and he was quite specific about the number of attendees.
I have the guest registry and seating chart.
Wait, are you sure this is accurate?

Hey, yeah. We can't count Basileus as a sacrifice because he's the vessel,

so this chart leaves them one short.
Wait, you don't think Graht would offer himself up as a sacrifice, do you?

That man is not the volunteering type.

He's more the sort to sacrifice anything and anyone to claim power for himself.

So...what, then? Did he miscount?

I mean, that's a VERY specific number, and it seems weird he'd get it wrong.

Aaah ha ha! Oh, but this is a delight! Don't you see? The missing number only means

there is a final attendee whose name needs no inclusion on a guest list.
Wait, who isn't on a guest list?

Of course.

The whole point of the holiday is a celebration of the Auspex, remember?
Which means the final sacrifice is Pope Origa.

Curia of the Ilian Church of Grams

August Cathedral

Auspecalia Ritual Hall
All of the attendees have arrived, Your Eminence—including Her Holiness.
Then everything is ready for the rite.

Yes, Satan will indeed have his offerings. Oh, but it is close now... 

So very close. Everything is within my reach, and soon it all will be mine!

Yes, and congratulations on all that, Cardinal!

Seizing literally "everything" really is the dream, mmm?

Decided to come after all, eh, Harle? 

Well, I suppose all of your help earns you a front-row seat for Satan's rebirth.

Harle? ...Ha ha! Oh, that's right!

I was still using that name with you, wasn't I?
And what is that supposed to mean?

Oh, nothing of consequence. But truly, what a momentous occasion this is.

At long last, all of your dreams will finally be realized.
It has been a struggle—one which took far longer than I initially anticipated.
Nnngh?! What is that? What's happening?!

Those are the demonic entities born of the miasma! Stop that at once!

You can't just kill the sacrifices—there is a ritual that must be followed!

Impossible... Why aren't they stopping?!

They're bound by the sealing stone, so why won't they listen?!
AH HA HA HA HA HA HA!
What are you laughing about, you little weasel?!

Oh, but you must forgive me.

Your panic was just so delightfully awkward!
Still, if I've offended, let me make it up to you with a little secret.

Shut your double-crossing mouth, fool!

You may have ruined my plans, but I'll have these demonic entities rip you apart!

I rather doubt that, you could pour every ounce of mana you have

into that common pebble and it won't accomplish a thing.
A common... No! That's not possible!

Oh, but it is. The moment the demon was released from its seal,

it became no different from any roadside rock.
Basileus! You controlled the demonic entities in Rozcimea, remember?!
Use your stone now and purge this traitor! Have them tear him limb from limb!

I hate to disappoint, but that won't be happening either.

Just like yours, Basileus's stone is now devoid of power.
Then how were these entities even summoned?!

Well, with the Five Archdemons freed and all the sealing stones spent,

only a demon possessed of miasma can do that.
A demon...? But that means you're—?!

That's right! I'm a demon through and through!

But you can call me...Loki.
And you knew all along, Basilius?!

What madness is this?! You were willing to give your body to become Satan's vessel! 

You wanted to fulfill my grand design!

You are a fool. Did you truly believe——

I would give my life for a scheme born of your staggeringly meager imagination?

I've lived until this day for the purpose of taking my vengeance against you.

Why would I offer you ANYTHING?

You slaughtered my village just to test some worthless new weapon—

though it was over a decade ago, so I doubt you even remember the incident.
You mean that village of heretics? You survived that?

But...but that was all necessary to reach the position I'm in now!

Surely you must understand I had no other choice!
And now you have no choice but to accept a pathetic death, humiliated and broken.

Don't! Stop this, Basileus! Th-there must be something you want.

Say it! Anything! Whatever it is, I shall make it yours!

My only wish is revenge for the home you put to the torch...

and for his will to be granted.

Your floundering has ceased to amuse me, and I trust you've had your fill as well.

It's time for you to finally be of some use.
We're sure this is the right way?
Yes, Graht and Basileus should be in the ritual hall just past this... What?!

Hello, Gabriel. Hello, everyone.

Where are you off to in such a rush?

As you say, we're in a hurry—

so if you try to stop us, we won't hold back.

An impressive threat!

But sadly, I can't stand down until Basileus's grand design is brought to fruition.

What grand design?

What does he hope to accomplish by bringing Satan back to life?

Why do you even ask? Would a persuasive answer win you over,

or will you just respond with some trite speech on the emptiness of revenge?
So revenge is what he's after?

Oh, it's not so simple as all that.

It's true this will serve as revenge, but it has all become so much more.

A statement so vague as to be pointless.

Give an answer with actual substance.

Oh, Sandalphon. Isn't it time you grew a bit of a personality?

Even androids don't sound so mechanical these days.

Well, I suppose some things never change.

I may not be able to give you the perfect answer, but I can tell you this much...

Basileus's village was wiped out by Graht and his own predecessor—

the previous Wing of War.
As I am connected to that Sigil, needless to say I was also there when it happened.

But wouldn't that make you another target of Basileus's revenge?

I never felt that sort of hostility between you, but...

It seems I was on his list at one point,

but we managed to talk through it and reach a kind of accord.

In truth, I was being deceived by Graht at the time.

He told me only that it was a village of heretics hell-bent on disrupting the world's order.
Shameful as it is, I had no idea I was being played for the fool until Basileus told me the truth.

They always took every precaution not to be found out,

and I never thought to doubt my own apostle's loyalty.

Still, those are all excuses. Basileus may have forgiven me after opening my eyes,

but I haven't forgiven myself—which is why I swore to help him find justice.
Even if what he seeks is ultimately unjust, I must atone for my part in that atrocity.

I'm confused.

Why does a man of Basileus's stature need power badly enough to resort to such measures?

Afraid I can't share that part.

But surely it isn't so hard to come up with reasons a person might seek more power?

Why, just the other day there was a greedy cardinal

lusting after Satan's power in order to rule the world.
Though his was a dream fated to end as nothing more than that.
I take it from your tone that Basileus has already claimed his revenge?
Ha ha! Oh, who can tell? Honestly, I wouldn't take anything I say too seriously.

That mana... It would seem he does intend to fight us.

But there's no way he can win—which means he's just trying to buy time.

I will always be on Basileus's side.

If he wished it, I would make an enemy of the entire world.

That is my choice—and my atonement.

So apologies, my friends, but his dream demands I stop you here!

content.content:
In the blink of an eye, demonic entities swarm the crowd, and the slaughter of the 666 begins.
As the apostles and angels race to the site, they find the way blocked by the angel Michael.
